source: Permatex official TDS PDFs; text reviewed and technical evidence transcribed directly

documents.title: Permatex 5 Minute Epoxy Technical Data Sheet

propertyEvidence.chemistry: Two-part rapid-curing general-purpose epoxy; epoxy resin; 1:1 mix ratio by volume.
propertyEvidence.setTime: Fixture time: 8–10 minutes; may be handled after 15 minutes.
propertyEvidence.appearance: Final color: clear to slightly yellow.
propertyEvidence.cureTime: TDS states handling after 15 minutes; it does not specify a full-cure time in the extracted section.

documents.title: Permatex Super Glue, 2 g Technical Data Sheet

propertyEvidence.chemistry: One-component, solvent-free, low-viscosity cyanoacrylate instant adhesive; cures at room temperature.
propertyEvidence.setTime: Fixture time: 5–10 seconds on degreased steel, G10 epoxy glass, and aluminum; 40–60 seconds on oak.
propertyEvidence.lapShear: Tensile shear: steel 1,800–2,400 psi; G10 epoxy glass 2,200–2,800 psi; aluminum 1,200–1,600 psi; oak 1,100–1,600 psi.
propertyEvidence.substrates: Adheres to metals, alloys, plastics, vinyl, rubber, and ceramics; not suitable for untreated polyethylene or polypropylene.

documents.title: Permatex Super Glue Gel, 2 g Technical Data Sheet

propertyEvidence.chemistry: Instant-bonding ethyl cyanoacrylate adhesive in gel form for close-fitting surfaces.
propertyEvidence.appearance: Clear gel; specific gravity 1.05; mild pungent odor.
propertyEvidence.cureTime: Full cure within 2 hours; cures on exposure to moisture.
propertyEvidence.substrates: Effective on metal, rubber, glass, aluminum, ceramics, vinyl, alloys, many plastics, and other non-porous surfaces; does not bond polyethylene or polypropylene.

documents.title: Permatex Ultra Bond Super Glue, 5 g Technical Data Sheet

propertyEvidence.chemistry: Ethyl cyanoacrylate; premium, faster-acting cyanoacrylate super glue for porous and non-porous materials.
propertyEvidence.appearance: Clear, colorless liquid; specific gravity 1.10; viscosity 110 cP.
propertyEvidence.cureTime: Full cure within 2 hours; cures on exposure to moisture.
propertyEvidence.substrates: Metal, most plastics, laminated plastics, vinyl, rubber, ceramics, paper, wood, textiles, leather, synthetic leather, cork, and chipboard; does not bond polyethylene or polypropylene.

targets.name: Permatex® Ultra Bond Super Glue, 5 g

documents.title: Permatex Black Silicone Adhesive Sealant Technical Data Sheet

propertyEvidence.chemistry: Single-component, moisture-curing RTV oxime silicone rubber; general-purpose adhesive sealant.
propertyEvidence.cureTime: Tack-free in 1 hour; full cure in 24 hours.
propertyEvidence.hardness: >18 Shore A after 7 days at 25°C/50% RH.
propertyEvidence.substrates: Metal, glass, wood, plastic, silicone resin, vulcanized silicone rubber, ceramics, natural and synthetic fibers, painted surfaces.
propertyEvidence.cautions: TDS says not recommended for engine gasketing applications.
propertyEvidence.productCodes: Ordering information: 81158 (3 oz tube) and 81173 (11 oz cartridge).

documents.title: Permatex Clear RTV Silicone Adhesive Sealant Technical Data Sheet

propertyEvidence.chemistry: Single-component, moisture-curing acetoxy silicone rubber RTV adhesive sealant.
propertyEvidence.cureTime: Tack-free in 1 hour; full cure in 24 hours.
propertyEvidence.hardness: >20 Shore A after 7 days at 25°C/50% RH.
propertyEvidence.substrates: Metal, glass, wood, plastic, silicone resin, vulcanized silicone rubber, ceramics, natural and synthetic fibers, painted surfaces.
propertyEvidence.cautions: TDS notes the curing process can corrode some surfaces; use the Ultra Series silicones for critical applications.
propertyEvidence.productCodes: Ordering information: 80050 (3 oz tube), 80855 (11 oz cartridge), and 85913 (7.25 oz PowerBead).
